description_en: Queries the list of historical event delivery tasks
description_zh: 查询数据回补投递任务列表
name: ListDeliveryHistoryJobs

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page in a paged query.

Valid values: 1 to 100.
Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

取值范围：1~100。
默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the task list.

Minimum value: 1.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
任务列表的页码。

起始值：1。
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

DeliveryHistoryJobs.description_en: The list of historical event delivery tasks
DeliveryHistoryJobs.description_zh: 投递历史事件任务列表

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the historical event delivery task was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the UTC time zone. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'
CreatedTime.description_zh: 补投递任务的创建时间。时间遵循 ISO 8601 标准，使用 UTC 时区，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range of historical events covered by the delivery task. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the UTC time zone. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'
EndTime.description_zh: 补投递覆盖的历史事件时间范围终点。时间遵循 ISO 8601 标准，使用 UTC 时区，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'

JobStatus.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

0: The task is being initialized.
1: The task is delivering events.
2: The task delivery is complete.
3: The task delivery failed
JobStatus.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：

0：任务正在初始化。
1：任务投递中。
2：任务投递完成。
3：任务投递失败

StartTime.description_en: The start of the time range of historical events covered by the delivery task. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the UTC time zone. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'
StartTime.description_zh: 补投递覆盖的历史事件时间范围起点。时间遵循 ISO 8601 标准，使用 UTC 时区，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'

UpdatedTime.description_en: The time when the historical event delivery task was last updated. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the UTC time zone. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'
UpdatedTime.description_zh: 补投递任务的更新时间。时间遵循 ISO 8601 标准，使用 UTC 时区，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the task list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数
